text_run.content: This operation drops the setting of the specified properties.
This method applies only to dedicated clusters.

milvusClient.dropDatabaseProperties({
    db_name: string,
    delete_properties: string[],
    timeout?: number
The name of the database whose properties are to be dropped.
There should be a database with the specified name. Otherwise, exceptions will occur.
Names of the properties to drop in an array. Possible database properties are as follows:
Number of replicas for the database.
Resource groups dedicated to the database.
Disk quota allocated to the database in megabytes (
Maximum number of collections allowed in the database.
Whether to deny all write operations in the database.
Whether to deny all read operations in the database.
The timeout duration for this operation.
indicates that this operation timeouts when any response arrives or any error occurs.
This method returns a promise that resolves to a

{
    code: number
    error_code: string | number,
    reason: string
A code that indicates the operation result. It remains
An error code that indicates an occurred error. It remains
